//: DRAFT: the layout is a first pass; the id, the door ids and the part ids are permanent. A hidden room under the castle. East: the opening behind the throne, five tiles tall (a body thrown through the throne room's window arrives high and drops to the floor; a walker arrives at floor level), and a doorway that comes up in the castle street for now (it is meant to come up in the courtyard). West along the passage: steps of one-way platforms up to a ledge (columns 16-17) at the mouth of a crawl exactly one tile high and five long (row 4, columns 11-15), which only a body at most a tile tall fits. It leads to the secret chamber (columns 5-10). INTENT: the chamber has a second way out that any body can take, a hole in its floor (columns 6-7, two tiles wide so the widest body fits) dropping eight tiles into the passage (the flyer's jump and three flaps reach about six and a half), too far to come back up by jumping or flapping: nobody who gets in is ever stuck, and no place here is leavable by one party member only. Getting in some other way (thrown up the drop by a friend) must keep working; do not close it. At the west end a cracked wall (column 4) seals a small vault. The opening back to the throne room is not marked hidden on this side, so it shows as an opening here; in the throne room the same connection is hidden and painted as wall.
name: Undercroft
